findings.claim: The CI validation step invokes the npm script instead of the required shell-free entry point command.
findings.evidence: The continuous-integration requirement says each job SHALL run OpenSpec validation through `node scripts/spec-validate.mjs`, and its scenario says the validation step is `node scripts/spec-validate.mjs`; the diff changes the step to `- run: npm run spec:validate`.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the workflow step to `- run: node scripts/spec-validate.mjs` and update `rules/test/ci-workflow.test.mjs` to expect that exact command.

findings.claim: spawnExecutable does not reject a bare tool name that can only resolve to a .cmd/.bat script on PATH, so the required clear refusal is only implemented for explicit script extensions.
findings.evidence: The Script-only tools requirement says a request that could only be satisfied by starting a `.cmd` or `.bat` SHALL be rejected with an error naming the shell limitation and spawnNodeCli alternative; `spawnExecutable` only calls `refuseScript(name)` on the literal `name` before `spawnSync(name, args, ...)`, so `spawnExecutable("tool", [])` is not checked for a `tool.cmd`/`tool.bat`-only PATH resolution.
findings.suggested_fix: Before spawning, resolve the executable name against PATH/PATHEXT on Windows; if the only match is `.cmd` or `.bat`, throw the same refusal error instead of calling `spawnSync`.

findings.claim: The change hand-edits KBD-owned orchestrator state even though this platform-spawn plan explicitly excludes that file.
findings.evidence: The path ownership constraints mark `.kbd-orchestrator/` as KBD-owned repository state, and the platform-spawn plan says `.kbd-orchestrator/project.json` and `.kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md` are NOT edited by this or any change and the owner re-runs `/kbd-init --force`; the diff modifies `.kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md` by changing the `no-console-log-in-lib` check and adding a note.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert the `.kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md` edit and let `/kbd-init --force` regenerate any required constraint changes.
